records.localization_note: Use the full name already shown in Square for sugar, salt, honey and cooking oil. The shop and the inventory describe the same category.

records.speaker: Goods Info

records.source_meaning: Special foods such as caviar, shark fins and nuts. Delicacy fits at full width and distinguishes them from staples.
records.localization_note: Keep the established category term for prized food such as caviar and smoked salmon, with its last letters visible.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Pepper, cloves, saffron and other spices. The familiar category name distinguishes them from the separate cooking seasonings.
records.localization_note: The stock includes pepper, clove and other spices. This label distinguishes them from the broader seasonings.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Specialty indulgences such as coffee, tea, cocoa and tobacco. The category covers goods bought for enjoyment.
records.localization_note: The established name covers discretionary goods that include tea, coffee, cocoa and tobacco.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Alcoholic goods including wine, spirits and sake. Liquor Shop is a familiar umbrella name for an alcohol retailer.
records.localization_note: Keep the familiar collective category for the alcoholic drinks in this game's stock.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Gold, silver and platinum. The compact term is distinct from Ore Shop, and Precious Metals Shop exceeds the caption width.
records.localization_note: This compact heading identifies Gold, Silver and Platinum in the stock list. The form fits alongside the percentage at its native maximum.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Manufactured wares including glass, china, lacquerware and inlaid ware. Crafts signals the worked products.
records.localization_note: The category groups manufactured decorative items such as glass and lacquerware.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Fiber and woven goods such as wool, silk and their cloth. The existing compact label identifies the broad trade family; Textile Shop remains a clearer wording lead.
records.localization_note: The stock includes both raw fibers and finished cloth. Textiles also matches the Square's Textile Shop and fits the shared market-rumor sentence.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Luxury wares such as carpets, art and fine furs. The qualifier is already idiomatic before Shop.
records.localization_note: The category covers luxury goods, including carpets, antiques and artwork.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Aromatic products such as musk, frankincense and ambergris. Scents covers the trade ingredients without implying they are finished perfumes.
records.localization_note: The stock groups aromatics such as musk, frankincense and ambergris.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Decorative materials such as jade, ivory and coral. Jewelry distinguishes ornamental wares from the separate stock gemstones.
records.localization_note: Use the same name as Jewelry Shop for the category of ornamental materials. The Gems category remains distinct.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Pearls, diamonds and other precious stones. Gems clearly identifies the gem trade.
records.localization_note: The one-word category identifies gemstones and pearls in the trade catalogue.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Medicinal trade goods such as ginseng, quinine and cordyceps. Medicine spells out the category and fits in the original cell.
records.localization_note: Use the full category name shown in Square for ingredients such as ginseng and quinine.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Dye goods including indigo and cochineal. The category stays recognizable as a shop label.
records.localization_note: The established name captures the shared use of these coloring ingredients.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Arms and equipment including guns, cannon, blades and armor. Arms is concise and suits the period setting.
records.localization_note: The term covers the game's weapons and related equipment, including armor.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Unprocessed mineral goods such as iron, copper and tin ore. Ore distinguishes the shop from Metals.
records.localization_note: Keep the established mining category for ore and other mineral commodities.

records.speaker: Goods Info
records.context: The selected commodity appears above its category and city market percentage, next to the arrival calendar.
records.source_meaning: Miscellaneous supplies such as timber, leather and wax. Sundries identifies the miscellaneous category and avoids the generic Goods Shop.
records.localization_note: Use the existing shop term for the miscellaneous grouping of timber, leather, wax and related stock.
